category_scope: Ecofys (2013) 2010 sector allocation: Land Use Change combines the 10.3% deforestation/afforestation and land-use CO2 component with 4.4% agricultural soils. Industry subflows sum to 22.8% + 6.3% = 29.1% (headline rounded to 29%). These are not the modern EDGAR LULUCF categories, and the conceptual network has a separate layout convention.
evidence_status: Conditional numerical reconstruction. The stock-ratio multipliers are imposed on the historical annual component; matched spatial support, component provenance and stock-to-flux transfer have not been empirically established. Remaining components are held fixed in absolute amounts. No 2025 percentage, fossil-source error or atmospheric concentration correction is measured.
source_location: Single-page original Ecofys chart: Land Use Change lower sector block and Industry outgoing subflows; inspected as a rendered page, 18 September 2026.
rounding: All baseline percentages are source-displayed values. Derived numbers are conditional on those rounded inputs. Historical 26.15–32.60 labels are retained by attribution; nearest rounding of the displayed inputs gives 26.16–32.61.
